verdict.rationale: A public API for driving the product is a fair question for a hosted AI app builder like Bolt.new, but the evidence pack never documents one. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The GitHub MCP connector is Bolt acting as a client to other services, and llms.txt is a documentation index, so neither is an API for driving Bolt itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
